$comment: The AI Design Team, second permission layer. The plugin's own hooks already keep Linear read-only and require a typed approval before Figma edits in design-team sessions. Copy this permissions block into your project's .claude/settings.json to add Claude Code's own rules on top: Linear writes denied in every session of the project, Figma edits always confirmed by you. Patterns match the servers whatever you named them. Check your real tool names with /mcp.
